current.text: He left the Raptors and joined the Lakers this offseason.
Walker Kessler is the Lakers' starting center. Mamukelashvili projects as the backup center, with some minutes at the four next to Kessler. Kevon Looney is the other backup center option.
The Lakers have two open starting spots, mainly between Grimes, LaRavia and Mamukelashvili. Ziaire Williams might also start. J.J. Redick's rotation choices are unclear.
Whoever of the starting candidates comes off the bench should still play about 27 minutes.
His minutes should go up this season.
If Kessler is out, the Lakers would have to rely on Looney or Mamukelashvili at center.
He is worth a late-round flyer, more so if he starts. One expert loves taking him in tier nine.

durable.text: He is a good shooter. His value comes from volume and efficient three-point shooting, and his offensive underlying numbers are strong.
Experts agree he is a bad defender.
2025-26 was his breakout season and his only one in a regular rotation role. He was barely a factor in the playoffs.
